gaps.sentence: I regret ___ so rude to her at the party.
gaps.explanation: regret + -ing = feel sorry about something you did.

gaps.sentence: He spent months ___ the application, only to be rejected in minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'Spend time doing something' takes the gerund.

gaps.sentence: She keeps ___ about the exam results.
She couldn't resist ___ the last biscuit.
My boss won't ___ me take Friday off.
gaps.explanation: let + object + bare infinitive: won't let me take. (allow/permit take to: allow me to take.)
bother + -ing (or to-infinitive): don't bother going. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: She would rather ___ at home tonight.
gaps.explanation: 'Would rather do' — the bare infinitive follows.
Negative infinitive: promised not to be late — 'not' goes before 'to'.
